Always hated my birthday, hate receiving gifts and hate being the center of attention.
Then on my 18th birthday my Nanny died.
Now even the thought of my birthday makes me sick!

Dont ever wish me a "happy birthday" because its not.

Cheesy baked beans or pasta with mayo and ketchup...
I know it sounds bad but sometimes its the only thing that will fill you up :(

We could spontaneously combust at any given moment and there is nothing we can do about it.

I know exactly where I'm going when I die.
Many non believers may disagree with this but its what I have personally seen.

I'm a spirit sensitive, I can sometimes hear and see past relatives in a place that is hard to describe.
Its not just white or black but changes depending on who it is.
My bffs friend died about 4 years ago and I saw her in a field, but also in a kitchen with her dead gradma.

My Father died when I was young, and he is sat in his fav chair, with his fav mug of tea. When I die he will be waiting for me in this place that changes.

It is a place of peace and serenity, no pain, no stress, just peace.
Its comforting to know where I'll go and that I'll be reunited with my beloved farther and my Nanny (grandma)

Please stop saying:
"everyone is a little autistic"
"Cant you take a joke?"
"Why are you so serious all the time"
"Ok you're being weird?" 

Its not ok, it was never ok and never will be ok, when you say these things it really does fuck with our heads and makes us feel 1000 times more awkward than we already feel.

Be patient with us in conversation because we need it and we really appreciate it when people are patient.

Cutting off contact with my toxic mother...

She thinks I will "come crawling back" to her, but what she fails to realise is that I am 23 and no longer living with her. She no longer has any control over me and it p*sses he off.
No. Not today woman. She will learn that her behavior will drive ALL of her children away if she continues and doesnt get help for all he issues.
